# Open-Assistant

[Open Assistant](https://projects.laion.ai/Open-Assistant/) is a large language model that can be used to generate text in a variety of domains. It is trained on a large corpus of text and can be fine-tuned on specific domains. Open Assistant is available as a web service and can be used to interact with a variety of assistants, including ChatGPT, Bing, and Yandex.AI.

## Getting Started

To use Open Assistant, you need to install the Open Assistant library. You can do this by following the instructions on the [Open Assistant website](https://projects.laion.ai/Open-Assistant/docs/getting-started/installation). Once you have installed the library, you can use it to interact with Open Assistant.

Here is an example of how to use Open Assistant to interact with Open Assistant:

```python
import open_assistant

# Initialize Open Assistant
assistant = open_assistant.Assistant('open-assistant', version='latest')

# Ask the assistant a question
response = assistant.ask('What is the weather today?')

# Print the response
print(response.text)
```

In this example, we initialize the Open Assistant library and then use it to interact with Open Assistant. We first initialize Open Assistant by passing in the name of the Assistant and the version number of the Assistant. We then use the Assistant.ask() method to ask the assistant a question. The Assistant will respond with the response, which we can print out to see what it said.

Open-Assistant is a project to create an open-source large language model.

## Table of Contents

Open-Assistant is a large language model that can be used for a variety of tasks, including answering questions, generating text, and providing information on a wide range of topics. The model is open-source and can be used by anyone for any purpose.

6. [Install the dependencies](https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant/blob/main/src/open-assistant/requirements.txt)
7. [Start the development server](https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant/blob/main/src/open-assistant/docs/running_the_server.md)
8. [Start the assistant](https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant/blob/main/src/open-assistant/docs/starting_the_assistant.md)

## Contributing
